column1: # Stem alternation of each conjugation class, by the start of the ending that follows.
# G applies the general phonology (으-insertion, harmony, contraction, ㄹ-deletion) after these rows.
#   class   REG HA D B BWA S H REU REO U EU L COP EXIST NC
#   before  A   the ending starts with the harmonic vowel 아/어 (어, 어서, 었)
#           EU  the ending starts with (으) (으면, 은, 을, 으니까, 으시)
#           ㄴ ㅂ ㅅ ㄹ ㅁ  the ending starts with this consonant, as a syllable initial or as a jamo
#           오  the ending starts with the syllable 오 (하오체 -오)
#   stem    actions on the last stem syllable, comma-joined:
#             final=X     set the final consonant (X a jamo, 0 = none)
#             append=X    add the syllable X to the stem
#             vowel=hieuh map the vowel for ㅎ stems: ㅏ→ㅐ ㅑ→ㅒ ㅓ→ㅔ ㅕ→ㅖ (그렇/어떻 etc.: ㅐ, flag `ae` in stems.tsv)
#             vowel=X     set the vowel to the jamo X
#             reu         르 → ㄹ on the syllable before it, the ending vowel becomes 라/러
#             drop-vowel  drop the stem's last vowel (으 stems): the ending vowel joins the consonant
#   ending  actions on the ending: drop-eu (no 으), keep-eu (으 even though the stem now ends in ㄹ),
#           harmony=dark|bright, contract=must, absorb (the harmonic vowel merges into the stem syllable),
#           vowel=X (the harmonic syllable becomes X), no-contract
